# 🚀 Job Application AutoFill

Zero-touch autofill for LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever.

---

## Step 1: Generate Your Profile

[Embed config.html form here]

Options:
A) Upload config.html to /static/ folder, embed as iframe
B) Link out to it: [Open Profile Builder](link)

---

## Step 2: Download the Extension

[⬇️ Download Extension (.zip)](paste your GitHub Release ZIP link here)

---

## Step 3: Install in Chrome

1. Unzip the downloaded file
2. Open Chrome → chrome://extensions/
3. Turn on Developer mode (toggle top-right)
4. Click "Load unpacked"
5. Select the unzipped folder
